Name: Joja Immersion (Joja Needs Nuance)
Author: CopperSun
Description:
Selling out to Joja is fun and convenient, but no one seems to notice. :( Sure, Pierre and Lewis act a little sad the first day you buy a membership, but that's it. And then when Joja fixes up the bus and minecarts, the villagers are like "Who could have done this mysterious deed?!??" Dude, I think someone would have noticed JojaCo construction equipment barging into town.

This mod fixes that by adding more lines of dialog than I cared to count! Every friendable character has a [i]minimum[/i] of 2 new lines (yes, even the Dwarf), and most have 5-8. Enjoy the saga of Shane and Sam working overtime, Vincent and Jas wanting to be included on the exciting nighttime activities, Pierre's growing conspiracy theory, and everyone telling you [i]exactly[/i] what they think you should grow in your repaired greenhouse. When you build the movie theater, they'll even clue you in on their favorite movies.
[u]

Configuration Options[/u]
Includes two configuration options for events:

Delay Ceremony - "True" delays the Joja Completion Ceremony by a week to allow time for NPCs to talk about the last improvement. "False" will result in overlapping dialog and feel less immersive.
        
Immersive Cut Scenes - A couple cut scenes are edited to fit the storyline; Willy at the boulder and the Joja warehouse ceremony. Choose "False" to allow another mod (like SVE) to edit those scenes instead.

[u]Mods in Screenshots[/u]
I took the screenshots while also running some of my favorite mods, [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580603-diverse-stardew-valley-dsv-seasonal]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]. The portrait modifications are NOT part of this mod.

[u]Compatibility[/u]
This mod adds conversation topics, overwrites a couple of original dialog lines, and edits a couple of events (configurable, see above). It should be compatible with almost anything, but [i]may[/i] conflict with the story being told in SVE's Joja route. Please let me know if this is or isn't the case.

[u]Making Your Own Mod[/u]
If you are interested in learning how to make your own dialog mod, the content.json file includes comments so you should be able to easily understand how it works. You may also be interested in this [url=https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Tutorial:_Adding_New_Dialogue]brief dialog tutorial[/url] on the modding wiki.

[u]Bugs[/u]
I've playtested this pretty thoroughly and it [i]should[/i] work just fine. The most likely potential issue is receiving a Joja receipt but being not able to read it from your mailbox. If you have this issue, just look in your mail collection to read the letter instead. If you do encounter any problems, however, please report them here.

Downloads.Description: For reasons I haven't figured out, "reveal taste" is not working correctly with some mod setups. To avoid having unsightly code appear on your screen, use this version instead. You'll get the same dialog, but NPC loved item reveals won't be recorded.
